Triage: graded — closing not planned. This is an honest, well-measured record of a fixture limit, and the record is the value; the card itself proposes no implementation.

Rationale on the four axes, briefly: standing coverage for the seven post-session gates already binds at the DOM level (7/12 red under ablation with green controls — `bootRedirectCoverage` suites), so no invariant is unguarded today; hardening the e2e probe (slower-boot fixture, later sampling anchor, or teardown-on-first-commit) is test-infra capability expansion with no current pull — startup-focus says don't build it speculatively; and the ablation methodology here (delete assertions that cannot fail) is exactly right and needs no further action.

Reopen is free if a real blank-frame regression on a post-session gate ever ships past the DOM-level coverage — that event would supply the pull this card currently lacks. The endpoint set under "Reusable material" stays findable here for whoever builds a signed-in mock boot next. Maintainer veto by reopening, as ever.
